_comment: TRANSITS cluster illustration plan (2026-06-09 batch). Hero = 1 diffusion image per article (gemini-web, no text). Inline = LLM-planned SVG infographics (gen-infographic.mjs), bilingual EN+ZH, wired by illustrate-article.mjs.

hero.prompt: A serene wide-angle cosmic scene: a single fixed constellation of pale gold stars holds steady in the foreground while, behind it, several planets of different sizes trace luminous arcing orbital paths at different speeds, the faster inner ones leaving short bright streaks and the slow outer ones nearly still. Deep indigo-to-near-black sky (#16112c fading to #0b0a1b), soft gold light (#d4af6a) catching the planetary rims, calm and introspective, editorial illustration, no text or letters.
hero.altEn: A fixed gold constellation against slow and fast planets tracing orbital arcs at different speeds in a deep indigo cosmos.
hero.altZh: 深靛蓝星空中，一组定格的金色星座衬着快慢不一的行星划出明暗不同的轨道弧线。

hero.prompt: An overhead view of a translucent circular star map lying flat like a still pool, its rim marked by faint gold zodiac glyph-shapes (abstract, illegible) — and above it, casting soft light downward, a few luminous planets drift across, their reflections meeting points on the fixed map below. Deep indigo-to-near-black palette (#16112c to #0b0a1b), warm gold accents (#d4af6a), two layers clearly visible: the still chart beneath, the moving sky above. Calm, contemplative editorial illustration, no readable text.

hero.prompt: A horizontal celestial procession illustrating a month's arc: on the left the airy, scattered light of Gemini with many small drifting points; a clear pivot at center where the light deepens into the slower, water-toned glow of Cancer; and on the right two close bright bodies — a full moon and a planet poised to turn back — hanging over a quiet horizon. Deep indigo-to-near-black sky (#16112c to #0b0a1b), soft gold accents (#d4af6a), introspective and seasonal. Editorial illustration, no text or letters.
hero.altEn: A left-to-right celestial arc from scattered Gemini light into deeper Cancer tones, ending on a full moon beside a turning planet.
hero.altZh: 一道由左向右的天象弧线，从发散的双子之光转入更深的巨蟹色调，止于满月与一颗即将转向的行星。

inline.altZh: 2026 年 6 月六个关键行运日期的时间线，从水星入巨蟹到 6 月 30 日满月与水逆。

hero.prompt: A wide twilight cosmos with a single large, warm-golden planet (Jupiter) rising as the clear focal point, its generous light opening across the scene like a new chapter; smaller, dimmer bodies sit low and quiet at the edges, two of them faintly reversing direction. Deep indigo-to-near-black sky (#16112c to #0b0a1b), rich gold glow (#d4af6a) around the great planet, expansive yet calm and introspective. Editorial illustration, no text or letters.
hero.altEn: A large warm-gold planet rising as the focal point of a deep indigo sky, with smaller dim bodies quietly turning at the edges.
hero.altZh: 一颗暖金色的大行星在深靛蓝星空中升起成为焦点，边缘几颗暗淡的星体悄悄转向。
